title: From centered increments to a two-time marginal balance
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement. Combine centered balance, a locally bounded primitive and Lebesgue differentiation.
target_statement: Write $\rho_t=(X_t)_\#P$. On the real time axis put $F(t)=\int g\,d\rho_{t^+}$ and $B(t)=\int A(t^+,w)\,d\rho_{t^+}(w)$, with $t^+=\max(t,0)$. Then $B$ is locally Lebesgue integrable, and $F$ is absolutely continuous on every finite nonnegative interval and satisfies the displayed identities.
